description: Volumes annuels d'électricité échangés entre responsables d'équilibre (2011 à 2021) is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Transactions commerciales annuelles (MWh) entre responsables d’équilibre (RE). Volumes échangés entre RE via les différents mécanismes mis à leur disposition: PEB RE-RE (échange de blocs de gré à gré), ARENH (Accès Régulé à l’Energie Nucléaire Historique), VPP (Virtual Power Plant), Bourses, Achat des pertes sur le Réseau Public de Transport (RPT) Zoom sur les transactions ... Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Marchés. Its keywords are Bilan annuel. The portal shows 2022-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
